verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a SaaS risk-management product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no bulk export of risk profiles, rules, lists, cases or transaction risk data in open formats. The only data-access items are the Disputes API, risk fields in webhooks and payment responses, and the Referrals API for uploading lists; these are adjacent developer building blocks, not a documented full-export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
